تبحبحنا (form IIq)
# تَبَحْبَحْنَا (tabaḥbaḥnā) /ta.baħ.baħ.naː/: first-person plural past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُبُحْبِحْنَا (tubuḥbiḥnā) /tu.buħ.biħ.naː/: first-person plural past passive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
